description.narrative: The objective of Danida’s support to Verdensmålenes Plads at Folkemødet is to increase public knowledge and engagement in the Danish development cooperation and the SDGs with a special emphasis on engaging students - prior, during and after Folkemødet. An additional objective in the project is to strengthen Kenyan civil society’s engagement in democratic participation and sustainability. Public engagement in Danish development cooperation is founded in the Law on International Development Cooperation and highlighted in the Development Policy Strategy “The World we Share” from 2021.

title.narrative: Through VMP and the projects primary target groups we have succeeded in engaging participants at Folkemodet Bornholm in topics and activities related to Danish development cooperation and the Sustainable Development Goals. The projects primary and secondary target groups have gained a better understanding of the Sustainable Development Goals and development cooperation as well as how they themselves can contribute.

Respondents from the projects target groups report that they have gained a better understanding of development cooperation and the Sustainable Development Goals and have learned more about how they themselves can contribute.

target.value: At least 80% percent of the projects primary target groups agree that after participating in activities before and during the VMP they can use their professional skills to contribute to the relevant Sustainable Development Goals and have gained an understanding of the topics relevance in the Global South.

actual.value: 77% reports increased knowledge of SDG's, 46% reports increased knowledge of development cooperation, 46% reports increased motivation

title.narrative: Each year, 30 students from the food and communications programs at FGU and vocational schools have participated in workshops leading up to the Peoples Meeting as well as at events at VMP, and as a result, they report having gained a better understanding of how their fields can contribute to sustainable development in Denmark and the Global South, respectively.

target.value: At least 4 events featuring Danida partners actively participating in VMP 2025, with attendance figures exceeding the average for events held in the Global Goals Tent.

actual.value: 62 events with an average of 142/145 attendees per event

title.narrative: The projects other target groups are exposed to the project through the press and social media
Media and social media channels that are relevant and significant to the project and its target audiences help tell the story of the students engagement

target.value: At least one national or regional TV channel, one radio program, one trade magazine, and one local media outlet will cover the story. At least two schools will cover the project on their own channels for the target audience.

actual.value: In 2024 TV2 Bornholm covered the activities during the Peoples Meeting, and in both 2024 and 2025, VMP was featured and reported on Globalnyt.dk before and during the Peoples Meeting. In addition, 12 students from FGU H and FGU MOS collaborated with 2030beyonds communications coordinator and their instructors on coverage of VMP. This resulted in a series of posts on the schools own Instagram accounts, where the project and the students engagement were shared through Reels and Stories. The student-created stories were also reposted via the Instagram profiles of HRS, the GLOBUS Fund, Danida, and 2030beyond, which has contributed to increased exposure of the project to a broader tertiary audience
